title: When the Tide Falls
author: Cyrus Coldharbour
blurb: Sable Dunmore, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
